text: dsh-tool-emoji 为 DSH Web 工具卡片替换前导图标，支持 emoji 和自定义图片并保留卡片内容。设置面板提供总开关、逐工具开关、图标编辑、图片上传及恢复默认，也能为错误状态设置图标。修改会即时应用，并在刷新后保留。配置保存在浏览器 localStorage，无需密钥或外部服务。

dsh-tool-emoji customizes leading icons on DSH Web tool cards with emoji or images while preserving card content. Its Settings panel offers global and per-tool toggles, icon editing, image upload, and reset. Config is stored in browser localStorage; no API key or external service is needed.

dsh-tool-emoji 的功能「工具图标设置」：在 DSH 设置页打开 Tool emoji 面板，可启用或关闭插件及各工具图标，修改 emoji，并恢复单项或全部默认值。
dsh-tool-emoji 的功能「上传自定义图标」：在工具设置行选择 PNG、JPEG、GIF、WebP 或 BMP 图片，限制为 1MB，并将读取结果保存为图标配置。
dsh-tool-emoji 的功能「替换工具卡片图标」：客户端注入 CSS，为 think、read、search、pwsh、edit 等工具卡片隐藏原图标并显示对应 emoji；错误状态可显示独立图标。
dsh-tool-emoji 的功能「即时应用并持久化」：设置变更后保存到 localStorage 并立即更新样式，页面存储事件也会触发样式刷新。

dsh-tool-emoji README · dsh-tool-emoji：[中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web plugin that replaces the simple leading icons in tool cards with emoji, **without replacing or removing any of the original card content**.

dsh-tool-emoji README · Mapping：| Tool | Emoji |
|---|---|
| `think` (reasoning row) | 🤔 |
| `read` / `web_fetch` / `grep` / `glob` / `web_search` | 🧐 |
| `pwsh` | 👨‍💻 |
| `edit` / `write` / `str_replace_editor` | ☝️🤓 |
| Any of the above cards in the error state | 😫 |

dsh-tool-emoji README · Installation：```sh
dsh-tool-emoji README · from a local checkout：dsh plugin --profile web add file:./dsh-tool-emoji

dsh-tool-emoji README · or from GitHub：dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/LWLAymh/dsh-tool-emoji.git
```

Then restart the web profile:

```sh
dsh --profile web
```

The plugin does not hot-reload into an already-running Web process.

Uninstall:sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-tool-emoji
```
dsh-tool-emoji README · Settings / Customization：In the DSH Settings page, open **Tool emoji** to customize every icon without editing code:

dsh-tool-emoji README · Settings / Customization：- **Enable / disable** each tool icon independently.
- **Enable / disable** the whole plugin from the master switch.
- **Custom emoji** — type any emoji/text into the input field.
- **Upload an image** — choose a local PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP to use as the icon (kept in `localStorage`, max 1MB per image; SVG is not accepted).
- **Remove an uploaded image** to fall back to the emoji text.
- **Reset one tool** or **reset all** back to defaults.
dsh-tool-emoji README · Settings / Customization：Changes take effect immediately on the chat page and persist after refresh.
dsh-tool-emoji README · dsh-edit-guardian compatibility：If `dsh-edit-guardian` does not have the `data-tool` attributes, the emoji will not be applied to `edit` / `pwsh` rows.

dsh-tool-emoji README · Notes：- The selectors rely on official source-level data attributes:
  - `data-tool="edit"` / `data-tool="str_replace_editor"` / `data-tool="pwsh"`
  - `data-variant="think"` / `data-variant="search"` / `data-variant="read"`
  - `[data-disclosure-row] > span:first-child`
- If a future DSH version changes these DOM structures, the CSS selectors may need to be updated.
- The plugin is Web-profile oriented; TUI/headless profiles have no leading-icon UI surface.
